mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, leading to higher S&P 500 valuations and positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is positive (>=0.03) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both below 3-month moving averages) occurs in more than 60% of periods with non-negative 60-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime (indicated by rising industrial production), manufacturing output growth supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a hawkish monetary policy response to rising inflation, increasing real interest rates and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (both above 3-month moving averages) occurs in more than 30% of periods without negative 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (indicated by strong GDP growth), consumer and business spending support corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth (quarterly) exceeds 2.0%.
